QuestInfo.name: No Pain, No Gain
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #b#p0020000##k in #b#m104000000##k and #b#m105000000##k who's toughed it through a challenging life.
QuestInfo.1: #p0020000# believes in the light at the end of the tunnel. He would like you to get some #b#t2020000#s#k to give to his wife, who has stayed by his side the whole time.\n\n#i2020000# #t2020000# #b#c2020000# / 10#k

0.0: Hmm... You look like you've been through some rough times. I've also experienced hardship...but enduring it has given me the peace I have now.
0.1: It's thanks to my wife that I lead a peaceful life. With her, I can keep up my Willpower and stay on the straight and narrow... Come to think of it, I haven't given her a gift in a while. Mind helping me out?

yes.0: My wife loves fresh produce, but it's hard to find any around here. Can you please bring me #b10 #t2020000#s#k? I hear you can get them from the 24 Hr Mobile Store inside an underground dungeon... I'm not sure of that, though.

no.0: Hmm... I thought you might understand.

1.1: Any future trials you face will be easy with your loved ones by your side. Your Willpower won't be added to by their help; it'll be multiplied.

item.0: You haven't found the #b10 #t2020000#s#k yet? I had heard that they were sold at the 24 Hr Mobile Store in some underground dungeon... Was that nothing more than rumor?

1.0: Oh, fresh #t2020000#s. Thanks! My wife will be overjoyed. I hope you also have someone like her to rely on. It doesn't have to be your spouse. Friends and guild members can also be great sources of support.
